Recall check

Name the five ledger fields without looking.

  1. Name the five ledger fields without looking.
  2. What does “cultural position” record that “source” alone cannot?
  3. Why is a screenshot of a search page not a cleared still?
  4. What belongs in “deliberate non-copy”?
  5. Where do FRD / AFA sit relative to stock libraries?

Course geometric background · coherence · #a8444d20854d · Original course SVG

Answers:

1. Source · reason · cultural position · transformation · deliberate non-copy.

2. Whose fashion world / power relation the image speaks from — not just the URL.

3. Platform pages are navigation evidence; item-level rights live on the object page.

4. What you refuse to reproduce (pose, body, motif) and why.

5. Documented non-Eurocentric research destinations — not anonymous texture packs.
